comment: Rocket Hideout B4F: Giovanni boss battle and the Silph Scope. In the source (pokered RocketHideoutB4F script) Giovanni's intro plays, the battle runs, his end-battle and departure lines play, and the Silph Scope is the item he leaves behind on B4F (PickUpItemText TEXT_ROCKETHIDEOUTB4F_SILPH_SCOPE) - this script grants it at the same point in the beat. Lines are exact bank labels (group RocketHideoutB4F), the bridge ref being TEXT_ROCKETHIDEOUTB4F_GIOVANNI. Battle identity = GIOVANNI party 1 (party_notes: 'Rocket Hideout B4F'; the bound placement's party_index). Completion flag rocket_hideout_cleared is authored here; losing sets nothing and the battle can be retried.
